messages:
Rae P: Final preflight for tomorrow's webinar. Need last confirmations: run-of-show published? who owns the demo "panic" swap? and are we split-testing CTAs in the post-email?

Diego M: Run-of-show is up at https://docs.redwood/webinar/run-of-show-apr. I'm owner of the demo swap. I'll be monitoring latency and will flip if >600ms for 20s.

Hannah V: For CTAs we decided A: dedicated trial, B: benchmark PDF + demo access. We'll A/B by randomizing the thank-you email link. Tracking param: ?wt=webinar_cta_A/B. Maya, you OK with email templates?

Maya S: Yup I'll schedule both and wire up the param to our analytics. Also adding a lead score tag: webinar_hot for >3 signups in 15m and webinar_warm for 1-3. That feeds SDR queue.

Rae P: Demo panic snippet for ops (one-liner):
```bash
# trigger demo swap to recorded fallback
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/demo/swap \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" \
  -d '{"mode":"recorded","url":"https://video.redwood/fallbacks/webinar_clip.mp4","reason":"latency_or_hallucination"}'
```

Diego M: I'll run that if health shows sustained spikes or hallucination. I'll also log prompt+response to secure logs for postmortem.

Hannah V: Rehearsal note: we added a short eval prompt set to exercise long generation tails (see doc). If caching misfires we'll catch it. Please run that during rehearsal.

DeployBot: [automated] smoke-check passed: GPU 49%, CPU 61%, avg latency 190ms, kv-cache hit 87%.

Maya S: Lead routing: webhook endpoint verified -> https://hooks.example.com/inbound/webinar-189012. On threshold, post to #sales-hot-leads and ping @oncall-sales. Otherwise batch every 30m.

Rae P: Great. Final asks: presenters join 20min early for AV check, speakers confirm slide numbers they reference, Diego keep the panic swap ready, Maya publish A/B email variants. See you at preflight in #marketing 09:50 PT.

Diego M: Confirmed.

Hannah V: Confirmed.

Maya S: Confirmed.
